title: Vertical Heat-Flux Gradient, Geothermometer Kinetic Disequilibrium & Depth-Compensated Basement Admittance with H33-Forensic 3-Stratum Completeness Allocation
hypothesis: Concealed geothermal feeder faults missing from public USGS/INGENIOUS Quaternary trace maps (existing_faults.tif) manifest where (1) positive shallow conductive vertical temperature gradients (dT/dz from T2m-T1m and T2m-T15m across 1,717 multi-depth 2-m probes) and multi-season thermal excess persist above survey backgrounds, (2) slowly re-equilibrating Na-K-Ca cation geothermometers exceed chalcedony and surface outflow temperatures (ascensional flash/conductive cooling & cold-aquifer mixing above blind roots), and (3) depth-compensated Salem isostatic-gravity tilt-wavenumber contacts, 150-m upward-continued magnetic structural-index persistence, and 10-m sub-pixel roughness-coherence piedmont breaklines localize the underlying brittle fault trace across relay tips (2-9 px), outboard piedmont bajadas (9-25 px), and blind basin interiors (>25 px).
mechanism: Range-front normal faults in the Great Basin step basinward 1.0-2.5 km into active alluvial bajadas (piedmont scarps) and >2.5 km into Cenozoic valley fill (intrabasinal accommodation zones and buried horst margins) where Holocene sedimentation erases subaerial scarps and 1/z^2 upward-continuation attenuates raw gravity gradients. Depth-invariant potential-field tilt zero-crossings weighted by Salem local wavenumber ||grad(theta)|| and depth-to-basement admittance recover buried density/susceptibility steps, while 1-2 m vertical probe gradients (q_z = -k dT/dz) and cation-chalcedony-outflow chemical disequilibrium (T_cat - T_chalc, max(T_geotherm) - T_outflow) pulled back up-hydraulic-head (+grad DEM) pinpoint actively convecting blind fault conduits.
named_non_fault_mimic: 1. Shallow non-tectonic volcanic flow lobes and basaltic cinder aprons (strong high-wavenumber magnetic edge that decays rapidly under 150-m upward continuation, high volcanic-vent proximity, and non-zero gravity tilt angle with no basement density step). 2. Closed-basin evaporitic playa brines and pluvial Lake Lahontan/Bonneville shoreline benches (1330 m / 1555 m contour flats with high shallow electrical conductivity cond_surf in negative detrended elevation det_elev < 0, zero basement gravity contact, and zero cation-chalcedony disequilibrium).

experiments_preregistered.description: Zero-catalogue crustal & hydrothermal disequilibrium discovery (44 physics + 16 VHGD = 60 label-blind channels; zero catalogue geometry features at inference).

Multi-expert Log-Odds Product-of-Experts (VHGD-60 + VESS-12 + TDKL-12 + B12-corrected VIS_STRUCT-23) with inverse-probability calibrated LightGBM dual-expectation heads and unconstrained Dinkelbach allocation for apples-to-apples holdout comparison against H88-ADHR (0.189634) and H88-VESS (0.200941).

Production emitted arm: H33-forensic 3-stratum completeness-decomposed Dinkelbach allocation (36,000 production dots at min_spacing_px=2.85: 6,480 [18%] near-tip 2<d<=9 px; 12,960 [36%] outboard piedmont/stepover 9<d<=25 px; 16,560 [46%] blind-basin d>25 px; fold-scaled 9,000 dots/fold on holdout).
